tasks.title: Reconcile PR #140 and its deferred documentation against the local tree
tasks.description:
## Requirements
- Read-only. No edits, no staging, no merge.
- Compare PR #140's changed files against the 345 dirty entries in this checkout.
- Collect CI status and review state for the PR head commit.
- Cross-check against PRPs/plans/phase14-one-stop-shop.md and phase15-layout-visual-content.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every PR #140 file has a disposition: already-local, diverged, missing, or superseded
- [ ] CI and review evidence recorded per head commit, not assumed from history
- [ ] Deferred items named in the PR body are listed with their current state
- [ ] Inclusion proposal written for operator approval

## Test Steps
1. `gh pr view 140 --json files,statusCheckRollup,reviews`
2. `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` and diff against PR file list
3. Confirm no working-tree mutation: dirty/staged counts unchanged after the pass
tasks.result: Read-only reconciliation complete. PR #140 head f051eb9: 100 files, 0 missing locally, 42 identical, 58 diverged. 13/13 CI checks SUCCESS on that head (auto-merge SKIPPED), but PR is draft, 0 reviews, REVIEW_REQUIRED, mergeState BEHIND - not eligible to merge. Key finding: local tree carries a self-referential navigation regression the PR does not; >=9 files under docs/best-practices/ link Best Practices to themselves while parent docs/best-practices.md exists. PR version is correct. No implementation performed; awaiting operator approval.

tasks.title: Inventory the dirty tree and assign ownership to every entry
tasks.description:
## Requirements
- Read-only pass over 345 dirty entries, including the 159 staged docs-rename files.
- Cover all three worktrees; do NOT operate on those under temp/.
- Group entries by apparent origin and intent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every dirty path assigned to a group with a proposed disposition
- [ ] Staged rename set characterised separately from unstaged and untracked work
- [ ] Worktree contents listed without modification
- [ ] Open question raised for any entry whose owner cannot be determined

## Test Steps
1. `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all`
2. `git diff --cached --name-status` for the staged set
3. `git worktree list`
4. Re-run status after the pass; counts must be unchanged
tasks.result: 243 dirty entries classified: 200 modified, 43 untracked. Two populations: (a) 151 files with equal +/- = mechanical link rewrites, INCLUDING 15 that introduced the self-referential Best Practices bug - all 15 are modified, 0 pre-existing, so the working tree introduced it; (b) 49 files with real content change, net -3610 lines. Sampled (b): .github/agents+prompts deletions are the deliberate Archon removal (harness-wizard 537->68 strips archon-* tools and hardcoded model) = KEEP. docs/features/variable-libraries.md 513->256 is a FACTUAL CORRECTION not content loss - v1 documented a Secret type with Key Vault binding absent from the official spec and omitted value sets; v2 cites Microsoft Learn = KEEP. 43 untracked split: 9 new docs/features pages, 13 docs README mirrors, 6 infra/ci-runners, 4 tests, AGENTS.md, FORGE_ORCHESTRATION.md. Ownership unresolved for the 15 self-ref files - operator decision pending.

tasks.title: Resolve the branch lag against origin before any dispatch
tasks.description:
## Requirements
- Branch docs/fabric-dr-authoritative-answers is behind origin by 3 commits.
- Determine what those commits contain and whether they conflict with local work.
- Do not merge, rebase, pull, or reset without explicit operator approval.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 3 upstream commits identified and summarised
- [ ] Conflict risk against the 345 dirty entries assessed
- [ ] Recommendation recorded; no history mutation performed

## Test Steps
1. `git fetch --dry-run` then `git log HEAD..@{u} --oneline`
2. `git diff --name-only HEAD..@{u}` intersected with the dirty path list
3. Confirm HEAD unchanged after the pass
tasks.result: Divergence, not simple lag: HEAD...@{u} = 1 ahead, 3 behind (my commit 6102ca0 is the 1). Merge base 710f889. The 3 upstream commits (c9cd67e merge, fa017bb, ca8fe01) touch exactly ONE file: requirements-docs.txt - mkdocs-redirects 1.2.2->1.2.3 and pillow 12.2.0->12.3.0, both dependabot bumps. That file is NOT locally dirty. ZERO collisions against all 243 dirty entries. Integration is therefore low-risk, but NO history operation performed - merge/rebase/pull requires explicit operator approval per spec. Recommendation: safe to integrate when approved.

tasks.title: Build the Fabric workload gap matrix from official sources
tasks.description:
## Requirements
- Map each workload to existing doc, sample, walkthrough, release status, evidence date, disposition.
- Cover Data Engineering, Data Factory, Data Science, Data Warehouse, Databases, Industry Solutions, Real-Time Intelligence, Fabric IQ, Power BI, plus OneLake, governance, security, lifecycle, capacity.
- Update existing coverage rather than duplicating it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed workload has a row with a dated evidence reference
- [ ] GA vs preview vs regional/SKU/permission limits distinguished per row
- [ ] Gaps proposed as phased scope, not implemented unilaterally
- [ ] Existing docs/features and docs/best-practices checked before proposing new pages

## Test Steps
1. Enumerate docs/features/ and docs/best-practices/ and match to workloads
2. Verify each claim against current Microsoft documentation
3. Confirm no new page is created without operator approval

tasks.title: Verify documentation build, links, navigation and search
tasks.description:
## Requirements
- Strict build behaviour; a workflow that tolerates missing content is insufficient.
- Check internal links, navigation entries, search indexing, sample downloads, rendered walkthroughs.
- Local verification only; no deployment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Build run and its actual output recorded, including warnings
- [ ] Broken internal links enumerated or confirmed absent
- [ ] Navigation and search reachability confirmed for changed pages
- [ ] Findings distinguish pre-existing breakage from regressions

## Test Steps
1. Run the documentation build and capture full output
2. Inspect the link-check step's real exit status, not just its summary line
3. `uv run pytest` for the repository test baseline
